description: Create structured notes from LaTeX selections with bidirectional PDF and SyncTeX navigation.
untrustedDescription: Reading remains available, but source writes and local LaTeX processes are disabled until the workspace is trusted.
configuration.title: LaTeX Paper Notes
configuration.dataFile: Project-relative path to the schema v3 structured notes data.
configuration.latexmk: Optional machine-local latexmk executable name or absolute path; a direct-engine fallback is used when unavailable.
configuration.pdflatex: Machine-local pdfLaTeX executable name or absolute path used for diagnostics and builds.
configuration.xelatex: Machine-local XeLaTeX executable name or absolute path used for diagnostics and builds.
configuration.lualatex: Machine-local LuaLaTeX executable name or absolute path used for diagnostics and builds.
configuration.makeindex: Machine-local makeindex executable name or absolute path.
configuration.synctex: Machine-local SyncTeX executable name or absolute path.
configuration.kpsewhich: Machine-local kpsewhich executable name or absolute path.
